name: style-graphite
title: Graphite
description: A high-contrast neutral Neumorphism UI style with deep shadows and quick motion.

light.neu-shadow-inset: inset 3px 3px 9px rgb(31 39 50 / 0.17), inset -3px -3px 9px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.94) 97%, transparent)
light.neu-shadow-primary: 4px 5px 11px rgb(31 39 50 / 0.17), -4px -4px 10px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.94) 94%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #3f536f 72%, white)
light.neu-shadow-primary-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #3f536f 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #3f536f 78%, white)
light.neu-shadow-destructive-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #c8545f 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #c8545f 78%, white)

dark.neu-shadow-inset: inset 3px 3px 9px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.48), inset -3px -3px 9px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.045) 97%, transparent)
dark.neu-shadow-primary: 4px 5px 11px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.48), -4px -4px 10px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.045) 94%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #b2c2d8 72%, white)
dark.neu-shadow-primary-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #b2c2d8 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #b2c2d8 78%, white)
dark.neu-shadow-destructive-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #ff7885 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #ff7885 78%, white)
